title: Kruznabir's Asylum Amulet

sources.title: Crown of Madness
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to temporarily charm a humanoid creature and induce madness in their mind. The affected creature then makes a melee attack against any creature aside from the caster within its reach.

summary: Cast level 2 Crown of Madness once per Long Rest.

fields.Crown of Madness: Action, 60 ft, target a non-Undead Humanoid. On a failed Wisdom save against your spell save DC, the target attacks a nearby creature other than you, even an ally. Concentration for up to 3 turns. It can repeat its Wisdom save at the end of each turn.
fields.Base value: 125 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
